title: Andy Reid: It looks like Josh Downs, Patrick Mahomes have a little connection going

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Andy Reid: It looks like Josh Downs, Patrick Mahomes have a little connection going
sources.description: The early returns from the Chiefs' trade for receiver Josh Downs were undoubtedly positive, as the wideout caught four passes on five targets for 53 yards with an 18-yard touchdown.
